source: OpenStreetMap road network via the OSRM public demo server (router.project-osrm.org), driving profile
limits: Free-flow speeds from OSM tags: no winter conditions, traffic, ferries or opening hours

Points are the main settlement of each municipality (OSM Nominatim) snapped to the nearest road, not exact home locations (snap_m shows the snap distance); where no settlement was found the municipality centroid is used
OSRM demo server is for light use; terms should be checked before production use
Not Digiroad: the national road database was not downloaded
